name: swapserver
description:
Submarine swap server for an Electrum daemon.

Example setup:

  electrum -o setconfig plugins.swapserver.enabled True
  electrum -o setconfig plugins.swapserver.port 5455
  electrum daemon -v
debitmydata_disabled: Disabled in DebitMyData-Electrum: Bitcoin-only service, needs Lightning, or no DebitMyData support on the device.
